Name: Dell Monitor Brightness
Description: Adjust a Dell U2720Q (or any DDC/CI monitor) brightness from your Ulanzi Deck.

Localization.IconQuickPicks: Quick picks. Search for more icons.
Localization.IconHint: Search covers the full Material Design Icons library; press Enter to use an exact name such as mdi:monitor. The Brightness Display tile dims its icon colour with the monitor brightness.
Localization.DdcHint: Brightness is controlled over DDC/CI (VCP 0x10), the same channel Dell Display Manager uses. The monitor must have DDC/CI enabled in its OSD menu.
